spec_match.rationale: Motivates the marker field by profiling four genuinely different workloads (CPU loop, allocation storm, layout thrash, style recalc) with the real Profiler and comparing trace shapes.

interactive.rationale: Run and Clear work; per-workload shapes and pairwise comparisons rendered from live traces.

edge_cases.rationale: The would-add column is explicitly labelled a reader aid, not a measurement, and the page will not print a marker it did not receive.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite sound; conformance route header defect recorded on marker-field-probe.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Four real profiles taken on this build; console clean; screenshots clean.

accessibility.rationale: Buttons named, aria-live outputs, visible focus.

summary: Verified on headless Chromium 153 (Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12) driven over CDP via a Playwright script — chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this cloud environment; desktop 1280×800 and mobile 360×740 DPR3 screenshots captured and inspected. The four-workloads comparison is a strong motivation piece and runs real profiles on this build.
